about: Experience Syphon Filter™ 3 originally released on the PlayStation® console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.
Special agents Gabe Logan and Lian Xing stand accused of conspiring to spread the fatal Syphon Filter virus around the world.

However, the trail of treason leads straight to their former employers – The Agency, and only Gabe and Lian can uncover the covert conspiracy and stop the virus in its tracks. But before they can look to the future, they must face the horrors of their past…
Play as Gabe Logan or Lian Xing – Discover the truth about their pasts and the genesis of the deadly Syphon Filter project.
Missions include stealth, assassination and all-out combat, plus a wide range of mini-games including evasion, retrieval and demolition.

More sophisticated weapons, including the Mine Sweeper, the Heartbeat Sensor, and the Steyr AUG – an assault rifle with infra-red scope and high velocity bullets, allowing you to see and shoot through walls.
A host of secret bonus missions and the new extended two-player deathmatch mode deliver maximum longevity and replay value.

This title has been converted from the PlayStation® version to the PlayStation®4 and PlayStation®5 consoles and provides newly added features. Consequently, there may be times where the title plays differently from the PlayStation® version, or where some features may cause the title to not function properly. This version does not support the PlayStation® console’s peripherals, therefore some functionality may not be available.
Remote Play allows users to connect to and play games on their PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5 using a mobile device, PC, or another PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5.
summary: Experience Syphon Filter™ 3 originally released on the PlayStation® console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.
